title: Linear Weekly Digest via MCP
summary: Read recent Linear issues and post a weekly digest to Slack, using the Linear and Slack MCP servers.
trigger: Manual run, or attach a weekly schedule in Studio
setup: In Studio, open MCP Servers and connect Linear and Slack from the registry (OAuth, no keys to paste). Keep the server ids `linear` and `slack`.
Run the playbook with your team key and a Slack channel id.
If a tool name or argument differs in your MCP server version, adjust the call in steps/*.ts (use Studio's tool list for the exact names).
Add a weekly schedule once the output looks right.
